notifications.title: A notes email was not sent
notifications.body: The notes email for Zoom 81234567891 was not sent: that address has already had 1 notes email in the last 24 hours, which is the daily limit. Your notes are in the app, at /meetings/2.

notifications.title: We updated our Privacy Policy
notifications.body: We now email you when the notes of a meeting are ready, and the Privacy Policy says what that email carries, that our email provider (Resend) receives it, that we keep a log of the emails we send for 30 days, and that we keep a one-way fingerprint of any address we must not mail again. You can turn the notes email off in Settings, under Email preferences. Read the policy at /privacy.
